current_activity: Division z.b.V. 471 (Heckel) committed on the line Rheine-Lengerich-Iburg to block the Teutoburger Wald passes
notes: Event date: 1945-03-28 (FMS B-414 (Geyer), German p.19 (Fold3 image 78, English p.32)). Event definition: on the evening of 28 March the training division z.b.V. 471 reaches the southern exits of the Teutoburger Wald and is committed by the First Parachute Army along Rheine-Lengerich-Iburg-east of Iburg to block the roads; it repels the British spearheads and takes in the LXXXVI Corps remnants after the two-day defence of Münster. Event support: one source family (FMS, German postwar manuscripts). Location: Lengerich (Westfalen), North Rhine-Westphalia (place PL3606) with a precision of 10 km. Location support: the text names Rheine, Lengerich and Iburg; Lengerich is a representative point. Commander: Generalleutnant Karl Heckel.
